data.title: Several phrasings go to search as a repeated --also, fused by reciprocal rank over one shared index
data.why: Answers the plan's open question 1. The question stays the positional argument, so every existing call means what it meant; the phrasings are a set, so their order changes nothing; each phrasing keeps its own decision to stay silent, and fusion only ranks what some phrasing answered. On the 50 held-out questions with three blind phrasings: first place 26 -> 30, top three 38 -> 40, top five 40 -> 43, silent 1 -> 0. One index for every phrasing: 67 ms for four in-process against 261 ms built four times; 150 ms end to end.
data.rejected: Several positional queries: kadence search a b c reads as one question to anyone who forgets the quotes, and the shell splits it that way; Query expansion inside kadence (a glossary or co-occurrence): measured before — the glossary fitted the golden misses and moved nothing else, relevance feedback cost 0.04
